Interface ImportSelector

All Known Subinterfaces:
DeferredImportSelector
All Known Implementing Classes:
AdviceModeImportSelector, AsyncConfigurationSelector, CachingConfigurationSelector, TransactionManagementConfigurationSelector
public interface ImportSelector
Interface to be implemented by types that determine which @Configuration class(es) should be imported based on a given selection criteria, usually one or more annotation attributes.

`ImportSelector` 可以实现以下任意一个 `Aware` 接口， 并且它们相应的方法将在调用 `selectImports(AnnotationMetadata)` 之前被调用：

  • EnvironmentAware
  • BeanFactoryAware
  • BeanClassLoaderAware
  • ResourceLoaderAware

或者，该类可以提供一个构造函数，包含以下支持的一个或多个参数类型：

  • Environment
  • BeanFactory
  • ClassLoader
  • ResourceLoader

`ImportSelector` 实现通常与常规 `@Import` 注解的处理方式相同，但也可以推迟导入项的选择，直到所有 `@Configuration` 类都已处理完毕（有关详细信息，请参阅 DeferredImportSelector）。

Since:
3.1
Author:
Chris Beams，Juergen Hoeller

    • getExclusionFilter

      default @Nullable Predicate<String> getExclusionFilter()
      Return a predicate for excluding classes from the import candidates, to be transitively applied to all classes found through this selector's imports.

      如果该谓词对给定的完全限定类名返回 `true`，则该类的导入配置将不被考虑，同时也会跳过类文件加载以及元数据检查。

      Returns:
      用于跨级导入的配置类的完全限定候选类名称的过滤器谓词，或者如果没有则为 `null`。
      Since:
      5.2.4
